title: Syrian-Style Chicken Kebabs with French Spices
description: A fusion dish that combines the flavors of Syria and France, perfect for a dinner party. The combination of spices and herbs will transport your taste buds to the Mediterranean.

ingredients.name: syrian spices
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, syrian spices, french thyme, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the marinated chicken cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
